workflowInfo.workflowDescription: Proves REXX syscall output to USS file bridged to shell STDOUT

variable.name: OUTPUT_FILE
variable.label: USS Output File Path
variable.abstract: USS file the REXX step writes to and the shell step reads from
variable.description: Full USS path for the capture file. Must be writable by the workflow owner. The shell step cats this file to STDOUT so the output appears on the JES spool.

step.name: rexxWriteUSS
step.title: Shell: Write Output to USS File
step.description: Runs as a shell-JCL job under ANDRE. Writes a timestamped report to the USS capture file using shell redirection — no SYSTSPRT involved.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh OUTFILE="${instance-OUTPUT_FILE}" echo "Writing to: $OUTFILE" echo "=== REXX USS Capture Test ===" > "$OUTFILE" echo "Strategy : shell redirect to USS file" >> "$OUTFILE" echo "Timestamp : $(date)" >> "$OUTFILE" echo "Running as: $(id)" >> "$OUTFILE" echo "System : $(uname -n)" >> "$OUTFILE" echo "Output : $OUTFILE" >> "$OUTFILE" echo "=== End of output ===" >> "$OUTFILE" echo "SUCCESS: written to $OUTFILE" ls -l "$OUTFILE"

step.name: catOutput
step.title: Shell: Cat USS File to STDOUT
step.description: Runs a shell-JCL step that cats the USS file written by the REXX step. The content appears in this step's JES spool STDOUT DD — visible in z/OSMF and via Zowe CLI.
step.instructions: Reads ${instance-OUTPUT_FILE} and writes it to STDOUT. Open the JES spool for this step's IZUWFJB job to see the REXX output.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh echo "=== REXX USS Capture Test - catOutput step ===" echo "Reading: ${instance-OUTPUT_FILE}" echo "----------------------------------------------" if [ -f "${instance-OUTPUT_FILE}" ]; then cat "${instance-OUTPUT_FILE}" echo "----------------------------------------------" echo "SUCCESS: file read and printed above" else echo "ERROR: ${instance-OUTPUT_FILE} not found" exit 1 fi
